transport_evidence.malformed_json: Go SDK v1.8.0 closes stdio without a JSON-RPC response, exits non-zero, emits zero stdout bytes, and records the parse failure on stderr. TestStdioEOFMalformedAndFrameLimit asserts the exact close/EOF behavior because the SDK does not permit the application handler to return a parse-error frame.
transport_evidence.oversized_frame: A frame larger than 4194304 bytes closes the stdio session and exits non-zero without leaving a subprocess.

External conformance and stock-client checks are unverified, not not_applicable.

Claude Code is the only V1 stock client with executed end-to-end curation evidence. Codex and Gemini configuration projections are best-effort previews, not claimed supported until their blocked end-to-end checks pass.

Curator delivery is per client: verified skills_extension clients use MCP only; other integrated hosts retain native installation. Previously installed native copies are removed only when their bytes match the installation receipt (or, for legacy copies without a receipt, the embedded curator); edits are reported and preserved.

Per-server enable/disable toggle support is required before skillhub integrate splits profiles into dual entries (skillhub and skillhub-curation). Because no client has verified automated toggle support with verifiable source citations, all hosts keep one full entry.
